verdict.rationale: The README says any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint works and names self-hosted backends (vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama) alongside cloud APIs. The app lets the user enter their own endpoint and key and pick separate planner and actor models, so the agent can be pointed at a locally hosted model instead of a cloud API. Missing for 10: a documented local-model setup walkthrough, guidance on which local vision models perform adequately, and hands-on or independent corroboration of running fully offline.

support.subject: As a power user, the agent runs with a local model, so device control does not depend on a cloud API
